assumptions: The first planning step must be a single rolling task with task_id TSK-0001.
TechSpec invariants must be stated explicitly in both DoD and quality gates.

tasks.title: Bootstrap JurisParse MVP-1 Product Scaffolding
tasks.objective: Create first product deliverable scaffold toward TECH_SPEC MVP-1 (package skeleton, CLI command surface, config skeleton, test manifest, README run instructions).
scope_in: Add/extend JurisParse package scaffold and CLI entrypoint
Document local run steps in README
scope_out: End-to-end production ingest implementation against real Mongo/GCS
dod: cmd_plan accepts only one task and one ordering item, both equal to TSK-0001.
DoD explicitly states page_index remains 1-based (first page = 1).
DoD explicitly states idempotency: rerun on identical inputs creates no duplicate entities except ingest_runs.
DoD explicitly states lookup_sync resolves dynamic TBSearch IDs and does not use hardcoded TreatyID/DocTypeID values.
DoD explicitly states that when needs_ocr=true in MVP-1, segments are not created.
quality_gates: Gate: manager-plan validation rejects plans that do not explicitly assert page_index is 1-based.
Gate: manager-plan validation rejects plans that do not explicitly assert idempotency with no duplicates except ingest_runs.
Gate: manager-plan validation rejects plans that do not explicitly assert lookup_sync without hardcoded IDs.
Gate: manager-plan validation rejects plans that do not explicitly assert needs_ocr=true means no segments in MVP-1.
